data.body:
[P2] Fence operation settlement as well as admission

An operation admitted while open can still settle after disposal. For example, a replayed successful step awaiting an asynchronous `serdes.deserialize` bypasses `runInvocationCallback`. After the deadline rejects the wrapper, releasing that deserializer still fulfills the `DurablePromise`, resuming handler code and `finally` blocks in the expired invocation. Guard fulfillment and rejection of admitted operation promises, keeping them suspended after closure while preserving eager operation startup. Add a regression that holds a replay deserializer past expiry and verifies that the original handler never resumes.
